photo.label: Photo and suspension
photo.title: Start with a side photo of your bike
photo.description: A clear side-on photo makes the point marking more reliable.
photo.inputHelp: JPG, PNG or WebP. Maximum file size: 10 MB.
photo.lowResolutionWarning: This image is smaller than {{minimumPixels}} px on its longest side. Use a larger photo if possible: small images make the marking less reliable.
photo.suspensionHelp: The current analysis supports simple single-pivot designs.

errors.invalidFormat: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image. SVG files cannot be used as photos.
errors.fileTooLarge: Choose an image smaller than {{maximumSize}} MB.
errors.unreadable: This image could not be read. Choose a different file.

marking.label: Mark points
marking.title: Mark the six key points
marking.description: Follow the guide and click the exact centre of each part on the photo.
marking.instructions: Click the exact centre of this point on the photo. You can select any point below to move it again.
marking.allPointsMarked: All six points are set. Select any point below, then click the photo to move it.
marking.keyboardHint: After selecting a marked point, focus the photo and use the arrow keys to move it by half a pixel. Hold Shift to move it faster.
marking.canvasLabel: Bike photo used to mark suspension points

mainPivot.label: Main pivot
mainPivot.description: The centre of the pivot around which the swingarm rotates.

shockFrame.label: Frame-side shock mount
shockFrame.description: The centre of the shock mounting bolt fixed to the frame.

shockSwingarm.label: Swingarm-side shock mount
shockSwingarm.description: The centre of the shock mounting bolt attached to the swingarm.

bottomBracket.label: Bottom bracket
bottomBracket.description: The centre of the crank axle.

rearAxle.label: Rear axle
rearAxle.description: The centre of the rear wheel axle.

frontAxle.label: Front axle
frontAxle.description: The centre of the front wheel axle.

parameters.label: Parameters
parameters.title: Add the bike and shock measurements
parameters.description: Use the shock as a ruler for the photo, then add the values needed for the analysis.

calibration.title: Calibrate the photo
calibration.description: The distance between the two shock mounts tells us how much a pixel represents in the real bike.
calibration.pending: Enter the shock eye-to-eye measurement to check the scale of this photo.
calibration.invalidReference: The two shock mounts are in the same place. Go back and correct one of those marks.
calibration.highScaleWarning: Each pixel represents quite a lot of the real bike. A small marking change may noticeably affect the result; a larger side photo would be more reliable.
calibration.usableScale: This photo has a suitable scale for a first analysis. You can still return to the marks if any cross does not look right.

analysis.title: Bike and drivetrain values
analysis.description: These values describe the shock, suspension travel and gears used in the calculation.

eyeToEye.label: Shock eye-to-eye
eyeToEye.help: Measure from the centre of one shock bolt to the centre of the other.

shockStroke.label: Shock stroke
shockStroke.help: How far the shock shaft can move. This is not the bike's suspension travel.

chainring.label: Chainring teeth
chainring.help: The number of teeth on the front chainring used for the kickback estimate.

sprocket.label: Sprocket teeth
sprocket.help: The number of teeth on the rear sprocket selected for the calculation.

declaredTravel.label: Declared rear travel
declaredTravel.help: The rear suspension travel stated by the bike manufacturer.

sag.label: Sag
sag.help: The usual resting compression of the suspension. 30% is a common starting point.

results.label: Results
results.title: Your kinematics results
results.description: The curves and their explanations will appear here.

charts.title: Your kinematics curves
charts.description: Read each curve with its units, inspect an exact value with the pointer, or open its data table below.

leverage.title: Leverage ratio
leverage.description: How much wheel movement acts on the shock through the suspension travel.
leverage.tableCaption: Leverage ratio at each wheel-travel sample

kickback.title: Pedal kickback
kickback.description: Pedal rotation caused by chain growth as the rear suspension moves.
kickback.tableCaption: Pedal kickback at each wheel-travel sample

axle.title: Axle path
axle.description: The rear axle movement. Both axes use the same millimetre scale, so the path is not stretched or distorted.
axle.tableCaption: Rear axle horizontal and vertical position at each sample

preview.loadingDescription: We are sending the marks and measurements to the kinematics engine.
preview.loadingChartsDescription: The calculation is ready. We are loading the visual view now.
preview.errorTitle: We could not calculate this bike

errors.invalidRequest: Check the marked points and measurements, then try again. One of them does not form a possible bike geometry.
errors.network: We could not reach the calculation service. Check that the BikeMatch backend is running, then try again.
errors.server: The calculation service had a problem. Try again in a moment.
errors.unavailable: The calculation service is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.unexpected: Something unexpected happened while preparing the calculation. Try again.

wizard.placeholder: This step is ready for its next implementation task.
